text: Assumption: Concurrent calls for different controllers or disjoint channels are permissible — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Concurrent calls for different controllers or disjoint channels are permissible — is this correct?
norm: concurrent calls for different controllers or disjoint channels are permissible
assumption: Concurrent calls for different controllers or disjoint channels are permissible.
rationale: SWS_FrIf_05032 explicitly restricts non-reentrancy to the same channel of the same controller only.

original.text: Annahme: Nebenläufige Aufrufe für unterschiedliche Controller oder disjunkte Kanäle sind zulässig — trifft das zu?

original.rationale: SWS_FrIf_05032 schränkt die Nicht-Reentranz explizit nur auf denselben Kanal desselben Controllers ein.
